markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (97%)** · Confident · Careful review
Conformal set is InSitu only, but MUSK disagrees and neighbors lean Invasive [F5].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | InSitu 97%, Invasive 3% | Strongly InSitu |
| Conformal set | {InSitu} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.99 / OOD 1.0 | Not flagged as suspect |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | No | Different top class |
| Similar cases | 1 of 5 InSitu | Neighbors mostly Invasive |

## Tissue evidence
- **Benign stroma/fat** (region 4) · ↑ invasive · Scarce here; low score raises concept-model invasive term [F3] · Validated
- **Tumor-infiltrating stroma** (region 3) · ↓ invasive · Near typical; does not push toward invasive here · Validated
- **Tumor necrosis** (regions 7, 11) · ↑ invasive · Highest-scoring concept here; spot check failed · Unreliable
- **Atypical cells confined in ducts** (region 8) · ↓ invasive · Modestly above typical; associated with lower invasive likelihood · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing top 3 regions cuts invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion effect over random is 0.002 (CI includes 0); not shown to reflect classifier. Largest term here, normal lobules (0/20), is Unreliable; necrosis (3/20) too.

## Could be wrong if
- Class is actually Invasive: 4 of 5 neighbors are Invasive and MUSK picks another class.
- Blur (severity 3, simulated frozen section) may degrade features; reliability tracks errors only modestly (AUROC 0.69).

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 7, 11:** confirm necrosis; both carry high heatmap contribution toward invasive.
2. **Regions 3, 4:** look for tumor-infiltrating stroma versus benign stroma or fat.
3. **Region 8:** confirm atypical cells are confined within ducts.
